summarize_ATOMIC_RADII: summarize the ATOMIC_RADII dictionary mapping atomic numbers to radii in picometers
review_ATOMIC_RADII: review the ATOMIC_RADII dictionary for NaN entries representing unavailable atomic radii values
build_embedding_lookup: build a python module that looks up atomic radii from the ATOMIC_RADII dictionary by atomic number
create_radii_filter: create a function that filters ATOMIC_RADII entries to return only elements with valid non-NaN radii
test_ATOMIC_RADII: test the ATOMIC_RADII dictionary to verify all atomic numbers from 1 to 100 are present
